Nasser Ibrahim Al-Rashid (born 1939) (Arabic: ناصر إبراهيم الرشيد الليلا‎) is a Saudi businessman and US dollar billionaire. He is not included in the Forbes list of the world's richest people as his personal wealth cannot be assessed with much accuracy from publicly available information.

Nasser Ibrahim Al-Rashid was one of three Saudi Arabian businessmen to donate over $US1 million to the Clinton Presidential Center.[5]

His previous wife, Mouna Ayoub, a Lebanese woman, is considered to be a French socialite.
